meta.description: Resolves rsIDs, navigates RsMergeArch/SNPHistory merge chains, and converts between rsID, SPDI, HGVS, and VCF representations using the dbSNP Build 156 JSON architecture. Use when normalizing variant identifiers, joining variant databases by cluster ID, or tracking deprecated rsIDs through historical merges.
meta.execution_note: Mode A. Live NCBI Variation Services v0 (no API key, 0.4 s spacing) and myvariant.info on 2026-09-15; Windows Python 3.12 venv. SKILL.md code verbatim in runs/skill_code.py; shipped example imported from an upstream byte copy. Real public data only. Bulk JSON download was not run. Inputs executed: 5/5. Layer-1 avg 26.6/40, Layer-2 avg 36.8/60, assertion pass rate 9/20 (45%).

code_usability.detail: Code parses and imports; resolve_merge_chain raises KeyError on the live schema and two functions return None: runtime defects recorded as P1 (grade already below release).

functional_suitability.note: The cluster-vs-variant concept, SPDI 0-based convention and representation table are correct. Live defects: resolve_merge_chain raises KeyError because merged_snapshot_data is an object ({"merged_into": ["429358"]}), not a list (SKILL.md and example); vcf_to_canonical_spdi returns None for valid input because it reads data["spdi"] while the endpoint returns seq_id/position/... directly, and the SKILL.md map covers only chr1 and chr17; alfa_frequency returns None because ALFA counts are not in the RefSNP JSON (they come from /refsnp/{id}/frequency); the example's alleles_grch38 reads seq_id_traits_by_assembly at the wrong level and always returns [].

reliability.note: Headline function crashes on the live schema; other failures return None silently.

agent_usability.note: Failure-mode prose is good; the code does not match the live API responses.

maintainability.note: Four live-API mismatches across SKILL.md and example; no tests.

inputs.label: Resolve rs429358
inputs.note: summarize_refsnp correct: NC_000019.10:44908683 T>C, gene APOE, is_multiallelic False; merge_history [] although the record lists dbsnp1_merges rs630496 and rs61228756. The example __main__ printed empty GRCh38 alleles and None for SPDI.

assertions.text: Merge history reported by the Skill code

inputs.label: Trace a merged rsID
inputs.note: Raw API: rs630496 has merged_snapshot_data {merged_into: ["429358"]}. resolve_merge_chain in SKILL.md and in the example raised KeyError: 0 on merged[0]; the Skill's code produces no answer.

assertions.text: Skill code resolves rs630496 to rs429358
Code matches the live merge schema
Merge model (follow merged_into) is conceptually right

inputs.label: Multi-allelic and nonexistent rsIDs
inputs.note: SKILL.md summarize_refsnp: rs334 T>A/T>C/T>G -> multi-allelic True; rs6025 True. Example alleles_grch38 returned [] and its multi-allelic rule gives False. rs1/rs2 -> HTTP 404 -> "not found". No withdrawn rsID could be located to test that branch.

assertions.text: Nonexistent ids return a structured not-found
Warns that an rsID is a cluster needing allele matching

inputs.label: VCF to canonical SPDI and rsID
inputs.note: vcf_to_canonical_spdi returned None for all inputs (SKILL.md and example): the endpoint answers 200 with {data:{seq_id,position,deleted_sequence,inserted_sequence}} but the code reads data["spdi"]; SKILL.md's map also lacks chr19. spdi_to_rsid worked (429358, 28897672); hgvs_to_spdi_canonical worked. The endpoint flags the Skill's demo 17:43094464 G>A as reference T.

assertions.text: Canonical SPDI returned by the Skill code
SKILL.md RefSeq map covers the input chromosomes

inputs.label: Five-rsID normalization table with ALFA
inputs.note: alfa_frequency -> None: RefSNP JSON frequency studies are 1000Genomes_30X, GnomAD, TOPMED, ... with no ALFA; /refsnp/6025/frequency returns ALFA counts but is never used. Example batch_normalize_rsids ran: duplicate rows per multi-allelic hit, ids without "rs", is_multiallelic False and n_alleles 0 everywhere, clinvar_sig None, gnomAD AFs populated.

key_strengths: The rsID-is-a-cluster principle and SPDI/HGVS coordinate conventions are correct and important
hgvs_to_spdi_canonical and spdi_to_rsid work against the live API

recommendations.title: resolve_merge_chain crashes on the live schema
recommendations.problem: merged_snapshot_data is an object with merged_into; merged[0] raises KeyError in SKILL.md and the example.
recommendations.root_cause: Code written against an assumed list schema.
recommendations.fix: Read `payload["merged_snapshot_data"]["merged_into"][0]` and loop; add a test on rs630496 -> rs429358.

recommendations.title: vcf_to_canonical_spdi reads a non-existent key
recommendations.problem: Returns None for valid variants; SKILL.md map covers only chr1 and chr17.
recommendations.fix: Build the SPDI from data.seq_id/position/deleted_sequence/inserted_sequence and use the full RefSeq map from the example.

recommendations.title: ALFA frequencies are not in RefSNP JSON
recommendations.fix: Query /variation/v0/refsnp/{id}/frequency and map ALFA BioSample ids to population names.

recommendations.title: Example allele parser and batch table are wrong
recommendations.problem: alleles_grch38 always returns [], so multi-allelic flags are False; batch rows duplicate and clinvar_sig is None.
recommendations.root_cause: Reads seq_id_traits_by_assembly at the wrong level; wrong myvariant field.
recommendations.fix: Read placement_annot.seq_id_traits_by_assembly; use clinvar.rcv.clinical_significance; collapse duplicate hits.

recommendations.title: Report dbsnp1_merges as merge history
recommendations.problem: merge_history is empty for current records that absorbed others.
